name: Credential Theft Response
description: Automated response when credential theft is detected (MITRE T1003)

actions.name: Reset User Password
actions.description: Force password reset for compromised account

actions.name: Revoke Authentication Tokens
actions.description: Revoke all authentication tokens for compromised account

actions.name: Check Lateral Movement
actions.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -FilterXPath *[System[(EventID=4624 or EventID=4625)]] -MaxEvents 1000 | where { $_.Message -match 'logon type 10|administrator' } | Export-Csv -Path 'C:\forensics\logon_events.csv'

actions.name: Verify Golden Ticket
actions.description: Check for Kerberos golden ticket indicators
actions.command: klist; Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -FilterXPath *[System[(EventID=4768 or EventID=4769)]] -MaxEvents 500 | where { $_.Message -match '0x18' } | Export-Csv -Path 'C:\forensics\kerberos_events.csv'
